Software Developer Intern

Join Brightpath Systems

Brightpath Systems is a Calgary-based team building infrastructure tooling for logistics
operators. We are looking for a Software Developer Intern for the summer 2027 term.

What You Will Do
- Contribute backend services in TypeScript and Go
- Work with the DevOps team on deployment automation
- Participate in code review and design discussions

Requirements
- Enrolled in a computer science or software engineering program
- Experience with at least one backend framework

Duration: 4 months
This position is on-site at our Calgary office.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
